messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Sev2: High GPU memory usage + container restarts observed in pool inference-usw2-high. Symptom: OOM during prefill for large-context requests (>100k tokens). Multiple container restarts reported starting 03:10 UTC. Pager routed to #incidents.
meera_oncall: I'm picking this up, paging @ryan_runtime and @gabe_mlinfra. Observed increased 5xx rate in US-WEST-2.
ryan_runtime: attaching node logs now, looking at node inference-usw2-07. docker restarts loop and kernel OOM entries.
ryan_runtime: logs snippet:
```
Apr 18 03:12:10 node-07 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4567 (redwood-runtime) total-vm:2480000kB, anon-rss:280000kB, file-rss:0kB
Apr 18 03:12:11 docker: container 9f1a2c exited with code 137, restarting
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv
memory.used [MiB], memory.total [MiB]
31122 MiB, 32768 MiB
```
gabe_mlinfra: kv-cache seems to grow without bound for prefill streams with interleaved long-chats. Prefill allocations not trimmed when context length > ~120k tokens.
emily_support: support telemetry: AcmeCorp and BetaApps report streaming aborts starting 03:09–03:12 UTC. ~12 aborted streams / min, 503s on chunk send.
jessica_csm: pinged two key accounts with heads-up; they asked for ETA and mitigation plan.
meera_oncall: mitigation proposal: 1) hotpatch to enable prefill trimming (PREFILL_TRIM=true) on canary nodes 2) cap per-worker kvcache to 1GB 3) route very large-context requests (>50k tokens) to smaller model variant as fallback 4) avoid increasing eviction threshold (that could mask memory pressure)
ryan_runtime: prepping hotpatch for canary (2 nodes). Will enable PREFILL_TRIM and add kvcache cap. ETA ~8m to canary, then observe 5m, then gradual rollout.
incident-bot: Action created: hotpatch rollout (ryan_runtime) logged against incident-1867000000.
gabe_mlinfra: note: raising eviction threshold is risky; prefer trimming + routing. Also we should cap cached prefix sizes per conversation.
ryan_runtime: agreed. applying kvcache cap (1GB) + PREFILL_TRIM on canary now. Starting canary restart (1/2).
meera_oncall: traffic shift plan: move long-context routing (~15% of region traffic) from inference-usw2-high -> inference-usw2-standard while we roll. Initiating traffic-shift.
emily_support: update from support: observed regional 5xx rate peak ~7% of streaming requests. Impacted customers: AcmeCorp (alpha), BetaApps (beta). CS outreach in progress.
jessica_csm: sending status update: "We're seeing degraded streaming for very large-context requests; mitigations underway. ETA 20-30m for initial stabilization."
ryan_runtime: canary patch applied: PREFILL_TRIM=enabled; kvcache cap enforced. Observed canary memory usage flattening; no restarts on canary for last 4m. Starting gradual rollout to remaining nodes (2/6).
meera_oncall: monitoring: region-wide memory pressure decreasing after traffic-shift and patch. Keeping routing rules in place for long-context until full rollout stable.
meera_oncall: handoff note — handing on-call to @gabe_mlinfra for night rotation at 03:35 UTC. I'll remain available for questions.
gabe_mlinfra: :thumbsup: taking over. Will continue rollout verification and cap tuning. Please add follow-up tasks: postmortem, long-prefill regression test, add metric for kvcache growth by context-size.
emily_support: will consolidate customer impact numbers and include timeline for CS follow-ups in postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident update: severity downgraded to Sev3. Hotpatch rollout in progress and traffic shift applied. Next automated update in 2h or on status change.
